name: paper-go
description: Download a paper and its cited references, then summarize each paper's topic and strategy

apiKey.title: LLM API Key (optional)
apiKey.description: OpenAI-compatible API key used for AI summaries. Leave empty to use built-in extractive summaries.

llmBaseUrl.title: LLM Base URL
llmBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1

llmModel.title: LLM Model
llmModel.description: Model name used for AI summaries.

maxReferences.title: Max References
maxReferences.description: Maximum number of cited papers to fetch and summarize.
